result.document_summary: Berkeley Rent Board web page describing the Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance (BMC 13.106), which bars landlords from using criminal history in rental advertising, applications, tenant selection and tenancy decisions.
result.notes: Only one in-scope rule: the criminal-history screening restriction. Effective date is not stated on the page (only the April 14, 2020 passage date, with no formula for the effective date), so effective_date is left empty. Enforcement details (penalties, complaint process, notice posting) are folded into this single record.

rules.title: Berkeley Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or tenancy decisions, and must give written notice and an opportunity to respond before taking any action based on criminal history. Violations carry administrative fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation plus civil damages.
rules.key_value: Criminal history inquiries and use prohibited; fines $1,000-$10,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley with respect to current and prospective tenants, unless an exemption applies.

exemptions.label: Owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record lives in one unit as primary residence

all_of.text: an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence

exemptions.label: Units under a rental agreement allowing owner move-back per BMC 13.76.130 A.9

all_of.text: Units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back to their home in accordance with BMC 13.76.130 A.9

exemptions.label: Existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates

all_of.value: existing tenant sublet or roommate change
all_of.text: Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates

rules.exemptions_text: Exempt: lifetime sex offenders; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8 properties; owner-occupied 1-3 unit properties where an owner lives in one unit; units under an owner move-back rental agreement (BMC 13.76.130 A.9); existing tenants subletting or adding/replacing roommates.
